cuts.reason: Snaps to a near-subliminal (0.1s) reaction cutaway of the woman during the pause right after 'You're not listening to me,' letting her blank stare hang for a beat before he keeps talking.
Cuts back to the man's tight close-up as he resumes with 'I am literally looking at your face,' timed to the restart of dialogue after the micro-pause.
Pulls back to a wider two-shot at the table right as he launches into the longest, most escalating line ('You're waiting for me to finish...'), resetting the frame for the accusation's build-up.
Punches straight in on his face without a real camera move, landing right on the word 'were' -- the twist word that reveals he's already rehearsing his comeback -- for punchline emphasis.
Cuts immediately to the woman's guilty, wide-eyed reaction shot the instant the accusation lands, letting her silent expression deliver the joke instead of a line.
Hard cut to the black end-card/logo screen ('LOW BATTERY PEOPLE') once the reaction has had a moment to breathe, closing out the sketch.

reaction_shots.description: Flash-cut reaction shot of the woman during the pause after the opening accusation -- so brief it registers almost subliminally, a quick beat before the man continues.
Woman's guilty, wide-eyed, mouth-agape reaction shot after being called out for already planning her response -- the visual punchline of the sketch, with no dialogue over it.

pacing_notes: The cut opens with a 1.4s title-card/hook shot, then snaps into a nearly subliminal 0.1s reaction cutaway during the first pause -- an early comedic jab. It settles into a 1.7s close-up, then expands to the longest shot of the video (2.6s) to carry the escalating, multi-clause accusation line. Right on the word 'were' it punches into a much tighter, shorter (~1s) close-up for emphasis on the reveal. It then holds a bit longer (~1.4s) on the woman's silent reaction shot to let the punchline land, before a final ~1.2s hard cut to the end card. Overall the rhythm is not a steady acceleration but a wind-up-and-release pattern: shots lengthen through the setup and long accusation line, snap short right on the punchline word, then lengthen again for the reaction and outro.
